name: Halcyon Global Risk (fictional)
inspired_by: Large Western (US and UK) private security and military contractors of the type that grew during the Iraq and Afghanistan wars: well-funded, ex-special-forces operators, government and energy-sector clients, MRAPs and armoured Land Cruisers, contracted helicopters, and a corporate public face. No real company, logo or person is used.

doctrine.summary: The player's mirror image: a bigger, richer Western contractor with ex-special-forces team leaders, corporate legal cover and better kit. It fights the way the player does (8-strong teams in battle-buddy pairs, frags, flashbangs and smoke, deliberate casualty evacuation) but with more money: armoured Land Cruisers and MRAPs, a contracted helicopter, small ISR drones and heavier armour. It wins contracts on reputation and price, and when it loses one it may turn up anyway, to recover the objective for its own client or to collect a bounty on the player's team. It avoids civilian casualties when cameras might be watching, and is careless when they are not.
doctrine.fireteam: Two 4-man fireteams of two battle-buddy pairs each, team leader and 2IC; medic in every team; vehicle crews separate.
tactics: Deliberate, well-coordinated room clearing with frags, flashbangs and smoke
Overwatch from a marksman pair plus small ISR drone before every move
Armoured convoy movement with a lead MRAP and a QRF on standby
Helicopter insertion and casualty evacuation (contracted Bell 412)
Racing the player to the objective, then defending it
Bounty-hunter ambushes on the player's extraction route

squad_leader: HK416-pattern carbine with LPVO and suppressor

launchers: Javelin [in_game] (rare, only on contracts with a state sponsor)

body_armor.notes: High-cut ballistic helmets with NVG mounts (medium); plate carriers with ceramic front/back/side plates (heavy) for assault teams, medium for drivers and protective details.

vehicles.notes: Armoured (B6) Land Cruiser SUVs and 70-series pickups in company white or grey.
Ex-military MaxxPro MRAPs bought surplus, repainted (game assignment proposal).
Armoured full-size SUVs for protective details and the cartel belt.
Contracted Bell 412 for insertion and medevac.
Commercial quadcopters for ISR; armed only on some contracts (game hazard).

support_assets: Contracted Bell 412 for insertion and medevac
Small ISR drones on every operation
Client-provided air support on some state-sponsored contracts

as_target: rival_contractor_race (both sides chase the same objective)
Steal back a contract objective Halcyon has secured
Expose a Halcyon cover-up for an NGO or journalist client
Ambush a Halcyon convoy (only for clients hostile to its sponsors)
Survive a bounty-hunter ambush during extraction

rivalry.role: nemesis (default proposal): the most player-like rival
bids_on: Counter-terror raids and HVT captures for Western and Gulf clients
Oil, gas and port security in mesopotamia and persian_gulf_coast
Convoy and protective-detail work in horn_of_africa and yemen_red_sea
Kidnap-for-ransom recovery and executive protection in mexico_cartel_belt
rivalry.bidding_behaviour: Underbids the player by 10-20% on contracts with Western or Gulf clients; outbid on reputation when the player's rep with the client is low.
shows_up_as_enemy_when: The player takes a contract Halcyon bid on and lost (chance to appear as rival_pmc on the map)
The player works for a client hostile to Halcyon's current sponsor
The player exposes or embarrasses Halcyon (story beat)
rivalry.bounty_hunter_trigger: When the player's notoriety with Halcyon's clients passes a threshold, or after the player kills Halcyon operators in two consecutive contracts, a bounty team may ambush the player's extraction route.
defeat_rewards: Salvage of Western kit (HK416-pattern carbines, plate carriers, NVGs) at loot caps
Captured intel revealing upcoming contract bids (first pick on the next board)
Reputation gain with clients hostile to Halcyon
Halcyon's market share in the theatre drops for a time (more contracts for the player)
rivalry.escalation: Repeated defeats raise Halcyon's tier: more MRAPs, helicopter QRF, then a named team leader who recurs as a mini-boss.

notes: FICTIONAL company; no real contractor, logo or person is depicted. Inspired by large Western private security and military contractors. Proposed as the player's main nemesis because it mirrors the player most closely (same doctrine, better funding). Relations with usa, gbr and Gulf states are business ties, not alliances; those states never deploy alongside it in game. Its use of MRAPs and M-ATVs is a game assignment proposal (open question on who fields MRAPs).
proposed: everything (fictional faction): name, flag_colors, relations, theatres
